gloss: gut feeling; intuitive sense; firsthand feel

definitions.gloss: gut feeling; intuitive sense; firsthand feel
definitions.explanation: An intuitive sense or gut feeling about something, grounded in direct personal experience rather than data or theory. Often used of a practitioner's on-the-ground grasp of a situation.

examples.japanese: {肌感覚|はだかんかく}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{分|わ}かる→分かる：00463_wakaru⟧。
examples.english: I can tell by gut feeling.

examples.japanese: ⟦{現場|げんば}→現場：02723_genba⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{肌感覚|はだかんかく}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{大切|たいせつ}にする→大切にする：26940_taisetsunisuru⟧。
examples.english: I value the firsthand feel of the front line.

examples.japanese: ⟦{数字|すうじ}→数字：03361_suuji⟧⟦より→より：09476_yori⟧⟦も→も：00484_mo⟧、⟦{消費者|しょうひしゃ}→消費者：09866_shouhisha⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{肌感覚|はだかんかく}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{重視|じゅうし}した→重視する：26832_juushisuru⟧。
examples.english: We placed more weight on consumers' intuitive sense than on the numbers.

notes:
An intuitive feel for something built up through direct, hands-on experience, contrasted with knowledge from statistics or theory.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {肌感覚|はだかんかく}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{分|わ}かる→分かる：00463_wakaru⟧: to grasp intuitively
- {肌感覚|はだかんかく}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{合|あ}う→合う：10466_au⟧: to match one's gut sense
- ⟦{現場|げんば}→現場：02723_genba⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{肌感覚|はだかんかく}: on-the-ground feel

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{皮膚感覚|ひふかんかく}→皮膚感覚：29625_hifukankaku⟧: cutaneous/tactile sense — literal skin sensation, also used figuratively much like {肌感覚|はだかんかく}
- ⟦{直感|ちょっかん}→直感：07624_chokkan⟧: intuition — a sudden flash of insight, less tied to accumulated experience
